sections.big_picture:
Tamil Nadu's political scene in this 12-hour briefing (30 Oct 2026, 06:00 PM IST – 31 Oct 2026, 06:00 AM IST) was centered on major policy and party actions involving AIADMK, AMMK, BJP, DMK, MDMK, NTK, TVK. Across key administrative and constituency sectors, debates centered on Assembly, Courts & Policy, Centre–State Relations, Education & NEET, Elections, Government & Administration, Infrastructure & Economy, Public Protests & Labour.

Senior stakeholders and district leaders monitored state responses and opposition statements as legislative and regional schedules progress.
